課程介紹
課程將邀請業界專家分享實際案例，幫助學生通過實例理解理論知識，並建立基本的觀念。通過這門課程，學生將具備在城市環境中部署和運行先進機器人協作系統的能力，提升他們在AI和機器人技術領域的專業素養和實踐技能。

This course aims to teach students how to use the physics simulation engine Mujoco for robotic simulation and control while deepening their understanding of control theories such as LQR and PID through hands-on implementation. The course covers the fundamental operations of Mujoco, including environment setup, model creation, and dynamics simulation. Students will also explore state estimation and control strategies for robotic systems. Through practical exercises and projects, students will learn how to leverage Mujoco to test and validate various control algorithms, building a solid foundation for future research or development in robotics.
